briefdescription.para: Resolves a weight's glyph sheet file from its manifest-relative path.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest file; its parent directory is the one path rule this function applies.
The weight's ValueTree, holding its property keyed by Extensions::svg.

simplesect.para: The manifest's parent directory joined with the weight's svg path.

briefdescription.para: Derives the manifest file name from a font family name.

parameterdescription.para: The font family name.

simplesect.para: The family name, lowercased with spaces replaced by hyphens, and a ".md" extension.

briefdescription.para: Derives the PostScript name base from a font family name.

parameterdescription.para: The font family name.

simplesect.para: The family name with all spaces removed.

briefdescription.para: Builds the manifest of a new font family from the embedded default manifest.

detaileddescription.para: The default manifest is a bundled markdown file, so a family starts from one authored source instead of a copy of its values in code.

parameterdescription.para: The family name written into the default manifest.
The PostScript name base written into the default manifest.

briefdescription.para: Adds a table, with its heading, to the manifest from the default manifest.

detaileddescription.para: Gives a manifest that predates a table the rows that the default manifest holds for it.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document that gains the table.
The identifier of the table to copy from the default manifest.

briefdescription.para: Adds the glyphs heading and table to the manifest document.

detaileddescription.para: One row is added for each glyph group of sheetRoot, in sheet order, when sheetRoot is given. The default printable ASCII range, U+0021 through U+007E, is added when sheetRoot is nullptr.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document to add the section to.
The root element of an existing glyph sheet, or nullptr to build the default glyphs table.

briefdescription.para: Reads a table cell's raw text.

detaileddescription.para: The raw text is the cell's source text, so one reading works for parsed cells and for cells added in memory. The command fails when the row has no cell in the column, naming the table and the column.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document the row belongs to.
The table row holding the cell.
The identifier of the column to read.

briefdescription.para: Reads a glyphs-table row's codepoints, stripped of their backtick enclosure.

detaileddescription.para: A cell holding a single backtick is stored bare, since a backtick cannot enclose itself.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document the row belongs to.
The glyphs-table row to read.

simplesect.para: The row's glyph text, without its enclosing backticks.

briefdescription.para: Reads one colour from the manifest's colour table.

detaileddescription.para: The command fails when the colour table has no row for key.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document holding the colour table.
The colour row's key.

briefdescription.para: Parses a manifest file and validates it against the manifest schema.

detaileddescription.para: Every later reader trusts the returned document, so the schema is checked once, here. The command fails on a validation error, naming the file.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest file to read.

briefdescription.para: Serialises a manifest document to its markdown file.

detaileddescription.para: The command fails when the file cannot be replaced.

parameterdescription.para: The file that receives the manifest text.
The manifest document to serialise.

briefdescription.para: Reads the --weight option and checks it against the manifest's weight tables.

detaileddescription.para: The command fails when the option is missing, or when the manifest declares no weight table of that name. The failure names the manifest file.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed command line arguments; must carry --weight.
The manifest's font value tree, holding one child for each weight table.
The manifest file; named in the failure message.

simplesect.para: The identifier of the selected weight.

briefdescription.para: Builds, reads, validates and writes a font family's manifest document the markdown tables that declare metrics, font metadata, glyphs, guides, colours and each weight's own table.
